name: uma-build-advisor
description: Server-specific Umamusume build advice with verified Japanese game artwork and private inventory tools.

interface.longDescription: Plan server-specific Umamusume builds in ChatGPT using the versioned Japanese or Global game-data catalog and your private inventory. Connect the remote MCP server through OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel for private data access and updates. Includes fresh strategy research, six-card deck recommendations, legacy candidates, substitutions, an interactive view with Japanese in-game card and stat artwork, and inline images for card-specific banner advice. Native ChatGPT mobile availability depends on current MCP app support; a separate text-only GPT Actions route is documented as an optional fallback.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me plan a Japanese-server Umamusume build using my catalog and inventory.
